subject: Quick roadmap pulse: Is Redwood still on your roadmap?
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@artemislabs.io>
Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@artemislabs.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Redwood inference for Artemis — recap & next steps

Hi Evan / Sophie,

Thanks again for taking the time to demo Redwood yesterday — appreciated the thoughtful questions from the ML and infra teams. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- What we covered: hosted API for quick experiments, dedicated pools for predictable throughput, and private VPC deployment options for regulated data.
- Match to your needs: low-latency inference for real-time scoring (100ms P50 target), support for open-model variants, and audit logs for compliance.

Suggested next steps:
1) Trial access: I can spin up a short sandbox on Dedicated for your core inference pipeline (2–4 GPUs) for 2 weeks so your engineers can run end-to-end tests.
2) Security: shared SOC2 overview attached and we can start an evidence pull if you want to go down the private deployment path.
3) Commercial: attached a high-level pricing worksheet (MVP-pricing.xlsx) and an estimated monthly burn for the proposed capacity.

As a path forward — if you think trial access makes sense, reply with the preferred start week and any names for access. If procurement needs to be looped in, happy to include them.

Attachments: redwood-demo-recording.mp4 (link), MVP-pricing.xlsx

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

---

Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Quick roadmap pulse — should I archive this opportunity?

Hi Evan —

I wanted to close the loop on our conversation from January and the follow-ups in February. I haven't heard back from you or Sophie, so a quick pulse on where this sits on your roadmap would be great.

Options that work on our side (pick one with a one-line reply):
- Archive for now: you don't have the bandwidth this quarter; I'll close the file and re-open when you ping us.
- Hold for later: you'd like us to check back in on a specific date (tell me when).
- Proceed now: we spin up the sandbox and get procurement started (we'll need names and PO next).

If I don't hear back in a week I'll assume you'd like us to archive and I'll close the opportunity — happy to reopen any time. If it's easier, feel free to reply with which option and we'll act on it immediately.

For reference: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/AL-2026-003
Demo recording: https://drive.redwood.com/demo/redwood-demo-recording.mp4

Thanks for your time,
Karthik Iyer

Redwood Inference
